## What changed and why?

Describe the problem, the focused change and any related issue.

## Validation

List exact commands/results, platform/build versions and tests not run.
Distinguish host tests, build success, upload/readback and user-observed PS4 gameplay.
For documentation-only changes, say so. Do not claim untested compatibility.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe any impact on stock/DLC songs, existing custom libraries, plugin/INI
entries, format/capability compatibility or rollback. Write "not applicable"
when this change does not affect these areas.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused; behavior changes have regression coverage where applicable.
- [ ] Applicable version/changelog entries are updated (not required for docs-only changes).
- [ ] Validation results and remaining testing gaps are stated above.
- [ ] No game files, source songs, dumps, backups, personal configuration or secrets are included.
- [ ] Upstream licenses/attribution and installation/recovery safety checks are preserved.
